title: Agents Foundry — From organization to AI employee
targetContext: Guided QA assignment for an already configured organization with active employees. This is a target, not a measured benchmark; external integration setup is separate.

scenes.title: Build your AI workforce.
scenes.subtitle: Run it like a real organization.
scenes.narration: Meet Agents Foundry, the organizational layer for AI. Give AI employees a role, a team, and a clear boundary, with people in charge.

scenes.title: An onboarding target of
scenes.subtitle: 5–10 minutes.
scenes.narration: The guided onboarding target is five to ten minutes, once your organization and employee accounts are configured. Here is the QA assignment flow.

scenes.title: Start with the right role.
scenes.subtitle: Engineering → QA Engineer
scenes.narration: Start in your organization's admin workspace. Choose the QA Engineer blueprint and the active employees who will receive an agent.

scenes.title: One guided configuration.
scenes.subtitle: A name. A scope. Clear expectations.
scenes.narration: Name the agent and complete the blueprint questionnaire. Define its project scope, working environment, and configuration preferences. Review the enforced capabilities before assigning.

scenes.title: Configure once. Assign to your team.
scenes.subtitle: Up to 25 active employees per assignment batch.
scenes.narration: Create and assign. Up to twenty-five active employees can receive distinct agent instances from one setup. Each gets an employee-bound, signed assignment and separate conversation history.

scenes.title: A verified place in the workspace.
scenes.subtitle: Your assigned agents → Verify and use agent
scenes.narration: Employees open Your assigned agents and verify the agent before selecting it. The workspace checks the signature and ownership, connecting the role to the right person and organization.

scenes.title: Onboarded with boundaries.
scenes.subtitle: Plan freely. Review controlled actions.
scenes.narration: The QA employee supports planning. Browser execution requires human approval, and production deployment is denied. An approved run is ready for the next step; connected execution remains on the roadmap.

scenes.title: Your organization. Your AI team.
scenes.subtitle: Start with QA. Explore the wider workforce vision.
scenes.narration: Start with the QA foundation. Explore fifty-five specialist role concepts and the wider workforce vision. Build your AI workforce. Run it like a real organization.
